title: Seasonal Variation of Salinity in a Small Tidal Estuary

headings.text: Seasonal Variation of Salinity in a Small Tidal Estuary

key_sentences: We report twelve months of salinity measurements from a small tidal estuary.
Salinity at the upper station fell sharply during the wet season and recovered within six weeks.
Small estuaries respond quickly to changes in river flow.
Conductivity loggers were installed at three stations along the channel.
At the upper station, mean salinity dropped from 18 to 3 practical salinity units in January.
The middle station followed the upper station with a delay of about ten days.
River discharge is the dominant control on salinity in this estuary.
Future work will extend the record to a second estuary with a larger tidal range.
